acceptance_gate_results.principle: All four audit arms must retain every one of the 64 source units.
The uncertainty unit is the 16 independent source bases, not 64 correlated conditions.
Every fixed mutation must report an observed result even when it fails.
Promotion needs a paired accuracy gain that stays positive under base-group resampling.
A verifier gain cannot come from more confident wrong accepts.
Private authority fields must not enter any retained request.
A second parser must reconstruct all source decisions from raw bytes.
Real source use must beat the frozen source-replacement control.
Authority, replacement, labels, naming, and deletion checks must all behave as expected.
Every focused command must pass before terminal publication.

causal_control_rows.principle: An alternate label authority must not silently replace the sealed evaluator.

causal_control_rows.expected: changed public source hash is rejected
causal_control_rows.principle: A source edit must change authenticated input identity.
Label order must remain bound to each public unit before scoring.
A proof-preserving entity rename should not change either primary decision.

causal_control_rows.expected: missing call is a mismatch and censored row
causal_control_rows.principle: Deleted raw evidence must become a visible failure, never a smaller denominator.

field_principles.MODEL_SPECS: Declare models executable in this invocation; keep historical identities in hashed sidecars.
field_principles.acceptance_gate_results: Each criterion records expected, observed, passed, and principle; separate completeness and value.
field_principles.arm_summaries: Show every arm's raw numerators and denominators before a pooled comparison.
field_principles.authority_boundary: Keep public inputs, private labels, and the second parser in separate roles.
field_principles.causal_control_rows: Retain authority, renaming, replacement, deletion, and shuffled-label interventions.
field_principles.claim_boundary: A 16-base synthetic source pilot cannot support model-wide or GSM8K claims.
field_principles.duration_s: Measure monotonic elapsed time and disjoint phase spans.
field_principles.execution_venue: Host orchestration is host; identify real device execution separately.
field_principles.field_principles: Store explanations here; consumer values remain ordinary top-level fields.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: For blocked work name upstream, exact field or check, observed value, and expected value.
field_principles.historical_model_receipts: Refer to historical model evidence only through authenticated sidecar hashes.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Completed findings start complete_; external absence starts blocked_; retain the measured finding.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Use the recognized literal for actual computation, not an invented task label.
field_principles.inference_substrate_class: Use the correct no-LLM class for CPU replay and tests; never pad duration.
field_principles.invocation_counts: Separate attempted and completed loads and generation from usable answers.
field_principles.matched_coverage_risk: Report paired selective risk without choosing a threshold from private labels.
field_principles.model_invoked: Derive from actual calls, including failed or unusable generation.
field_principles.paired_comparisons: Use base-group confidence intervals and retain recomputable arm numerators.
field_principles.phase_spans: Record disjoint monotonic work spans for each phase.
field_principles.positive_control_results: Use matched direct self-consistency to expose headroom without calling it independent truth.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Record actual input hashes, authority separation, resource ownership, and failures.
field_principles.random_seed: Freeze independent-unit seeds before observing results.
field_principles.raw_replay_rows: Retain the second parser's disposition for every frozen raw call.
field_principles.replay_mismatches: Keep missing, corrupt, or inconsistent raw evidence visible.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Bind code, configuration, input manifests, and raw evidence.
field_principles.rows: Keep each unit, arm, seed, error, abstention, cost, metric, and censoring state.
field_principles.run_date: Use 20260913 and actual UTC start and end times.
field_principles.sample_size_budget: Record planned, attempted, completed, and censored units and the stopping rule.
field_principles.schema: Version the result and retain ordinary top-level experiment_id and milestone.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Preserve exact input identity, retirement, and quarantine status.
field_principles.source_audit_complete_score: One means every fixed row and independent check has a disposition, including negative findings.
field_principles.source_leakage_errors: Name any private authority field that entered a generation request.
field_principles.source_promotion_score: One only when all primary scientific and independence criteria pass.
field_principles.status: Use complete or blocked for terminal evidence; keep unfinished work in separate checkpoints.
field_principles.timestamps: Record actual UTC observations for task start and completion.
field_principles.validation_receipts: Retain command, exit code, timing, and log hash; do not hide failures.
field_principles.verdict_class: Use the closed verdict set. Oracle evidence forbids positive, and failed efficacy gates forbid positive.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: Expose shared verifier and evaluator authority; exact conformance is not learned correctness.

sample_size_budget.stopping_rule: authenticate and reduce every frozen raw call once; never stop on accuracy
